title: 第7章 给他们成为垫脚石的机会第8章 福报再见顾清秋
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
此话一出，本来喧哗震惊的顾家子弟，顿时就炸开了。
顾青和一众族老都是一脸惊色的看向顾阳。
这是……自家圣人老祖直接给顾长歌钦定神子了？
一众人脑瓜子嗡嗡的。
顾长歌内心一愣，但面色依旧保持平静，望着方才来到自已面前的顾阳老祖。
顾阳一脸和蔼的看着顾长歌，眼中满满的欣赏之色，虽说不知道顾长歌第二觉醒的天资是什么。
但从方才的恢弘场面来看，不用想都知道绝对是至强天赋了。
有重瞳再加上这第二个觉醒的至强天赋，再加上现在顾长歌已经是第一序列，所以他才会有这个提议。
“你意下如何？”
顾阳再次询问顾长歌。
顾长歌正想开口，可是一旁观望的其他支脉族老可坐不住了啊。
要知道现在神子之位没有定下来，他们支脉支持的其他序列，可是也有机会位列神子的啊。
现在顾长歌直接被老祖钦定神子，是什么鬼。
要是定下来了。
他们前面所做的事情，不是完全白费了吗？
长生世家上下对外一致，不生二心，但对内也需要有竞争力才行。
扶持自家支脉看好的天骄成为神子，就是竞争之一！
不过这个竞争是良性竞争，只会提供资源辅助目标天骄争锋，如果对自家人动手。
那就不好意思，得被其他人给肃清了。
长生顾家流传万古至今，自然有自已的处事方法。

倒不如说。
每一个屹立道域之巅的长生世家，不朽圣地，都有自已的一套法则。
虽说大同小异，但都是最适合匹配势力的运行法则。
“老祖！
此事还需要考虑啊。”
“对啊，自古以来，长生顾家便是依靠自身实力争锋，怎可以凭借展露一些天赋就定下神子之位。”
“斗胆谏言，这对于其他序列者来说，有所不公。”
一名名族老站出来开口。
顾青和主脉族老闻言，目光纷纷对视一眼，随即一名主脉族老站出来哼道：“有什么不可以？长歌可是天生重瞳，现在更是觉醒第二个逆天天赋，这等天资加持之下，谁是对手，更别说长歌乃是第一序列，难道第一序列还不能证明他的实力已经立于整个长生顾家年轻一辈之上？”
其他主脉族老连连开口附和。
“我感觉顾苏长老说的没错。”
“是极，第一序列代表什么，不用我们多说了吧？更别说长歌已修至命轮境。”
“十六岁的命轮，舍我其谁！”
主脉族老底气十足，目光笑吟吟看着其他支脉族老，自信非凡。
“你们！”
支脉族老气得吹胡子瞪眼。
顾阳见状微微点头，笑着看向那些反对的族老道：“现在序列当中可有命轮境？有的话让他出来和顾长歌一战，胜者老祖也可以钦定他为我长生顾家神子。”
顾阳话落，全场寂静。
支脉族老支支吾吾，面容一阵抽搐，因为这个还真没有啊。
“既然没有，那便听我安排吧。”

顾阳瞥了眼一众支脉族老，转身再次笑意吟吟看着顾长歌。
content_en:
As soon as these words came out, the children of the Gu family who were originally noisy and shocked suddenly exploded.
Gu Qing and all the clan elders looked at Gu Yang with shocked expressions.
Is this...the ancestor of our saint directly appointed the Son of God to Gu Changge?
Everyone's minds were buzzing.
Gu Changge was stunned inwardly, but his expression remained calm as he looked at Patriarch Gu Yang who had just arrived in front of him.
Gu Yang looked at Gu Changge with a kind face, his eyes full of appreciation, although he didn't know what Gu Changge's second awakened talent was.
But judging from the magnificent scene just now, it doesn't take much to know that it is definitely the strongest talent.
With double pupils, the second awakening of the strongest talent, and the fact that Gu Changge is already in the first rank, that's why he made this suggestion.
"What do you think?"
Gu Yang asked Gu Changge again.
Gu Changge was about to speak, but the other branch clans watching on the sidelines couldn't sit still.
You must know that the position of the Son of God has not yet been determined. Other sequences supported by their branches also have a chance to be ranked as the Son of God.
Now Gu Changge was directly designated as the Son of God by his ancestor. What the hell is that?
If it's settled.
Wasn't what they had done before completely in vain?
The Changsheng family is consistent externally and does not have two minds, but it also needs to be competitive internally.
Supporting one's favorite genius to become the Son of God is one of the competitions!
However, this competition is a healthy competition, and it will only provide resources to assist the target to compete, if they attack their own family.
Then I'm sorry, I have to be eliminated by others.
The Changsheng Gu family has been passed down for eternity, so they naturally have their own way of doing things.
Rather.
Every immortal family that stands at the top of the Tao Domain and the Immortal Holy Land has its own set of laws.
Although they are similar, they are all operating rules that are most suitable for matching forces.
"Ancestor!
This matter still needs to be considered. "
"Yes, since ancient times, the Changsheng Gu family has relied on their own strength to compete. How can they determine the position of the Son of God just by showing some talent."
"I dare to say that this is unfair to other sequencers."
An elder from the famous clan stood up and spoke.
Gu Qing and the elders from the main lineage clan looked at each other after hearing this, and then an elder from the main lineage clan stood up and hummed: "What's wrong? Changge was born with double eyes, and now he has awakened his second heaven-defying talent. With such talent, who is the opponent? Let alone Changge is the first rank. Doesn't the first rank prove that his strength is already higher than that of the younger generation of the entire Changsheng Gu family?"
Other elders from the main lineages spoke in agreement.
"I think Elder Gu Su is right."
"Yes, we don't need to say more about what the first sequence represents, right? Not to mention that Chang Ge has reached the Life Wheel realm."
"Who else would have a sixteen-year-old life wheel than me?"
The elder from the main clan is full of confidence. He looks at the other elders from the branch clan with smiles and is extremely confident.
"You guys!"
The branch tribe was so angry that they blew their beards and stared.
Seeing this, Gu Yang nodded slightly, smiled and looked at the opposing clan elders and said: "Is there a destiny wheel in the sequence now? If so, let him come out to fight Gu Changge, and the winner, the ancestor, can also appoint him as my immortal son of the Gu family."
After Gu Yang finished speaking, the whole place fell into silence.
The old man from the branch clan hesitated and his face twitched, because this really didn't exist.
"Since there is no such thing, then just listen to my arrangements."
Gu Yang glanced at the elders of the clan, turned around and looked at Gu Changge again with a smile.
